name: phil-bench
description: A benchmark of philosophy-focused questions designed to measure a model's ability to understand philosophical texts, answer normative and conceptual questions, and perform short-form argumentative reasoning. Tasks include question answering and short-answer prompts drawn from philosophical materials. It tests semantic understanding, conceptual distinction, and basic argument evaluation.
reputation: A niche, community-contributed benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited adoption outside specialized NLP/phil-logic evaluations.
